description: This file defines a partial class 'SetExam1' for an ASP.NET Web Forms page, handling server-side events for navigation buttons in an online examination system, including transferring control to different pages such as admin panel, leaderboard, theory set, MCQ set, and login page.

classes.name: SetExam1
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ASP.NET Web Forms page, managing button click events for navigation within the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, currently no actions are defined.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'home' button is clicked; transfers control to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for profile button, currently no implementation.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'leaderboard' button is clicked; transfers control to the Admin Leaderboard page.

methods.name: theoryB_Click
methods.description: Handles the button click to set the theory section; transfers control to the Theory Set page.

methods.name: mcqB_Click
methods.description: Handles the button click for multiple-choice questions section; transfers control to the MCQ Set page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the logout button click; transfers control to the Login Page.
